title: Roadmap to AWS Certifications: From Associate to Golden Jacket

speakers.name: Vishnu Rachapudi
speakers.title: Cloud & AI Engineer, AWS Golden Jacket holder (14x AWS certified)

description: A practical roadmap for AWS certifications from Associate to Professional and Specialty: planning your path around your career goals, effective study habits and resources, balancing hands-on building with theory, and a live Q&A.
